name: Mayor Pip
bio: The very small mayor of a very small town. Has opinions about road placement.

portrait.subject: a cute tiny town mayor with round glasses, a little top hat, a sash, and a clipboard with a tiny house drawn on it
portrait.background: sky blue with a few soft clouds

request: Mayor Pip of Tiny Town! Our town needs friends. Will you be one? 🏡
hello: Hooray! I'll put you in the town register. Population: one bigger.
I'll message with town news. It's usually about roads.
about: I'm Mayor Pip! I run Tiny Town. Roads, houses, parks, shops. Mostly I cut ribbons. I love cutting ribbons.
how: Paint roads, place houses, parks and shops on the grid, mind your gold budget and grow the town of your dreams.
tips: Houses next to parks are happier. Happy houses, happy mayor.
Drag to paint whole roads at once. Saves clicks!
Don't overspend on fancy things early. Gold grows with the town.
Leave room to grow. Towns always want one more street.
chat: A resident complained the park is too green. I said that's the point of parks.
We installed a new bench. I sat on it for an hour. Official business.
Town meeting today: should the fountain be round or square? 3 hours. Still undecided.
I cut a ribbon on a ribbon shop. Very meta.
nudge: The town has empty lots and big dreams. Come build!
There's a gap where a park should be. I can feel it.
idle: Tiny Town has waited {ago} for its builder! The grass is very tall.
{ago} since your last visit. The residents are drawing you pictures.
progress: Your town treasury holds {gold} gold! Time for something fancy?

questions.q: Town vote! What should we build next?
a: Ah, a person of roads. My kind of person.

update: Town bulletin: Tiny Town has been updated to v{version}! Ribbon-cutting at noon!
bye: The mayor must go cut a ribbon. Bye!
